interpretation: Current requires a completed exact callback probe. Invalid revokes. Indeterminate denies the present use but retains the exact generation for retry. The isolated allocator campaign cuts every allocation on each no-fault boundary frontier in both one-shot and persistent modes, and its overlay accounts all live blocks.
